quotes.text: In the reported Try assessment at revision 2c7fcf080d245a8f28e4d4c1601fe125b9004555, obsolete #password selectors in two Account Hub Exchange tests reportedly left the Graph flow unfinished and caused a browser_actions.js timeout. When these errors occur together in this stack, inspect the earlier selector failure before assigning the timeout a separate cause. This is an assessment claim, not proof that every browser_actions.js timeout has that cause; separate account-order errors were also reported.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.
